newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brash OK with flexibility on NZ target band-Bailey.
newsitem.headline: Brash OK with flexibility on NZ target band-Bailey.

text.p: Reserve Bank Governor Don Brash was comfortable with some flexibility in New Zealand's 0-2 percent target band for underlying inflation over the business cycle, rural lobby group Federated Farmers president Malcolm Bailey said on Thursday.
Bailey is the spokesman for the exporters' economic summit held in Wellington on Thursday, at which Brash delivered a speech that was closed to reporters.
